$comment: Not a schema: the closed RFC 9457 problem-type registry of the PiglorOS Gateway v1 contract (#301). Validated by scripts/check_gateway_contract.py.

problem_types.title: Invalid request
problem_types.description: The request does not meet the published request schema, header, path or query rules. Correct the request before retrying.

problem_types.title: Unsupported version
problem_types.description: The request names an API, schema or Event type version this Gateway does not support. Unknown required versions fail closed; there is no fallback.

problem_types.title: Incompatible profile
problem_types.description: The request binds an execution or conformance profile this deployment cannot serve.

problem_types.title: Unauthenticated
problem_types.description: No authenticated Principal or host authority is available for the request.

problem_types.title: Unauthorized
problem_types.description: The authenticated Principal holds no grant or capability for the operation.

problem_types.title: Consent invalid
problem_types.description: The consent state required by the operation is absent, malformed or does not bind the current Timeline position.

problem_types.title: Revoked
problem_types.description: The authority or consent the operation depends on was revoked before the accepted boundary. Exposed only to the authenticated subject.

problem_types.title: Deleted
problem_types.description: The protected data the operation depends on is frozen for or completed erasure. Exposed only where the caller may learn the erasure state.

problem_types.title: Not found or unavailable
problem_types.description: The resource does not exist or the caller may not learn whether it exists. The answer is identical in both cases and never enumerates resources.

problem_types.title: Admission rejected
problem_types.description: The request is well formed but the typed domain validation at admission rejected it. Nothing was committed.

problem_types.title: Approval rejected
problem_types.description: The host-owned ActionApprover rejected the proposed simulated action. Nothing was committed.

problem_types.title: Append conflict
problem_types.description: The Timeline state changed between the caller's observation and the serialization point (a stale observation or a stale Event cursor). Read the current state and decide again.

problem_types.title: Idempotency conflict
problem_types.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used for a request with different bytes. An exact retry returns the original result instead.

problem_types.title: Artifact missing
problem_types.description: A content-addressed artifact the operation requires is absent from the deployment.

problem_types.title: Artifact untrusted
problem_types.description: A required artifact failed its integrity or trust-policy admission.

problem_types.title: Replay claim insufficient
problem_types.description: The ReplayClaim of the requested closure is weaker than the operation requires; erasure never strengthens it.

problem_types.title: Dependency graph incomplete
problem_types.description: The recorded dependency graph of the requested Fork or Replay is incomplete under the declared frontier rule.

problem_types.title: Mixed Fork generation
problem_types.description: The request would combine outputs of different Fork generations; quarantined generations are never authoritative.

problem_types.title: Counterfactual incomplete
problem_types.description: The counterfactual recomputation did not complete; no partial suffix is exposed as authoritative.

problem_types.title: Resource limit exceeded
problem_types.description: A request, response, quota or storage bound was reached. The `retryable` member states whether an identical retry may succeed later.

problem_types.title: Temporarily unavailable
problem_types.description: A host dependency cannot serve the request now. An identical retry may succeed.

problem_types.title: Internal safe failure
problem_types.description: The Gateway could not complete the request. The detail is a fixed safe text; no host fault description leaves the Gateway.
